newsitem.title: USA: Nuclear Metals to demonstrate RocTec.
newsitem.headline: Nuclear Metals to demonstrate RocTec.

text.p: Nuclear Metals Inc said on Monday it will demonstrate its RocTec waste solidification technique at its Carolina Metals Inc subsidiary in South Carolina in a funded cooperative agreement for the U.S. Department of Energy.
The demonstration will use the RocTec technique to stabilize mixed waste incinerator fly ash generated at the Idaho National Engineering Environmental Laboratory.
"If this demonstration program achieves expected economics, it could result in a production facility being installed in Idaho," Nuclear Metals added.
